correctness.rationale: The area-normalized covariance of regular P_n is (1+2 cos²(pi/n))/12 times I, yielding kernel 1+kappa x·y. Convexity of the Lebesgue function reduces the endpoint norm to a vertex, and splitting the negative cap gives the signed shoelace integral. The angular-cell radius R=cos(pi/n)/cos(delta), effective disk scale 1-pi²/(3n²), and zero-mean/first-moment cell cancellation control the O(n^-4) remainder even across two absolute-value corners. Differentiating the disk Lebesgue constant gives 5 sqrt(15)/(4 pi), hence 5 pi sqrt(15)/(12 n²). Recomputed n=3,4,6 exact values and n=80,160,320,640 scaled excess tending to 5.06972334; these finite checks do not prove the asymptotic.
residual_risks: No global monotonicity in n proved; finite quadrature confirms only sampled n; angular-cell cancellation needs uniform Lipschitz bound at two moving corners, supplied in RESULT.md.
